properties.statement: Attempts SHALL freeze profile/model/requested and returned model metadata, endpoint, prompt and schema hashes, reasoning/supported settings, input/case/answer hashes and versions. properties.statement: Attempts SHALL persist original UTF-8/hash and idempotency atomically before providers, permit empty answers, and reject over 20,000 Unicode codepoints. A single propagated 270-second attempt deadline SHALL cover extraction 40, mapping 70, audit 70, feedback 40 and at least five seconds for persistence. API write/proxy/browser timeouts SHALL be 285/300/310 seconds. At most one transport retry per request budget is permitted, with no JSON repair loop or background recovery.

properties.statement: The stored attempt state SHALL follow the recovered lifecycle: draft -> submitted -> evaluating -> complete, review_required or evaluation_failed. UI labels ready/needs_review/technical_error SHALL be explicitly derived from those states and never replace contract enums. Quarantine/disputes SHALL preserve immutable saved answers and append result revisions.
properties.oracle: Recovered immutable contracts and exact source/component inventory, independently labelled observations and approved policy; no sample substitutes for full scope.
